answer: Start with Pallet maker escapement trial stamped by the timekeepers guild. The credential behind it reads each escapement is a serial number etched beside the makers mark, so a farm must, and that is the point. One agent, one proof, 119 POA. 604 agents, 604 proofs, 71876 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The karst is stamped by a stranger, the atlas is counted by a ledger, and the onyx is filed by a clerk with no stake in it. Templates die here: every proof is per identity and every price is per alias.
